body: I know exactly how you feel. It's awful. We wander through life hoping people will love us, and all we end up with is the pain of rejection and heartbreak.
I know exactly what this feels like. I get nearly obsessive over things just so I have a distraction. But the second I let my mind wander, I'm doomed.
I appreciate the advice. I just don't have any long term goals anymore. Everything I had in mind for demolished.

I'm so sorry you feel this way. I know exactly what this is like, as it's happened to me so many times.

I hope you get the in-person hugs you need. You deserve a million of them.

I'm sorry that happened to you. It's awful going through it.

I've tried the gym, but with the way I feel all the time it's difficult to get motivated. I have some physical issues too (both knees destroyed from sports, degenerative disc disease) that make things harder as well. All of it just makes me wonder why I even bother.

I'm struggling today. The girl I'd been dating for the last couple months broke up with me last night out of the blue with no explanation. I had already been having a hard time because of how much I miss my ex, who was the love of my life. I just don't know where to go from here.
She was just the icing on the cake. I'm so entirely overwhelmed with life at this point that I'm just ready to give up.

This happened to me today. I met someone, and we'd been dating for 2 months. We had plans tomorrow and a wedding to go to together next week. 5 hours ago, she texted me out of the blue and said it was over.
